section.catchline: Education and training for county assessors.

subsection.subsection: The commission shall conduct a program of education and training for county assessors that offers instruction on:a county assessor's statutory obligations; andthe practical application of mass appraisal techniques to satisfy a county assessor's statutory obligations.
The commission shall confer a designation of completion upon a county assessor each time that the county assessor completes the program under Subsection (1)(a).

section.subsection: A county assessor shall obtain a designation of completion under Subsection (1)(b) within 12 months after the day on which the county assessor starts a term of office.
